as_told.title: Donald Barr's sci-fi novel Space Relations about alien sex slavery

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that Donald Barr, a former officer of the OSS, the American wartime spy agency, was headmaster of the Dalton School, a private school in New York, around the time a young Jeffrey Epstein got a job teaching there in the 1970s. Michels adds that Barr wrote a science fiction novel called Space Relations, which he describes as a story about aliens keeping humans as sex slaves, and he links William Barr and Epstein into the tale. He calls it the weirdest thread tying Epstein to UFOs.
